items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: That was even time of Buddy Petit time and Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Yeah, you used to go at the Mellonbury. Yeah. And they used to have a pavilion out there. They called Manual Pavilion. And my brother used to play out there. That was even time of Buddy Petit time and Louis Armstrong.
I was wondering a little more about the West End. I never did know much whether... Did they have camps out there? They played over the water or were they night clubs?
